name: After § 54
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 54c. Underlines the failure of Union policies to prevent migration flows and human trafficking; reiterates its concerns about the role played by instruments such as the Internal Security Fund and the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund in the management of the effects of the migration and refugee crisis; stresses that the allocations should be devolved to repatriation and border security;
